slides.title: Ethiopia's water minister speaks on Egypt, Abay and Red Sea
Minister: Egypt's efforts "no longer effective"
slides.body: Habtamu Itefa says Cairo tried to block Abay projects and sea access.

slides.title: GERD flows "remained steady"
slides.body: He says water still reaches Egypt and Sudan downstream.

slides.title: Egypt's response not reported
slides.body: Single state-media source. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Dialogue, not escalation
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
